parts.text: How did AAPL's revenue change from fiscal year 2022 to 2023?

Apple Inc. reported Total Net Sales of $383,285 million in FY2023 compared to $394,328 million in FY2022, representing a decrease of $11,043 million (-2.80%) due to macroeconomic headwinds in hardware sales.
